overview_description.description: MeltPlan is an AI-native planning engine designed specifically for construction, focusing on automating takeoffs and ensuring building code compliance. The platform aims to streamline preconstruction workflows, enhancing productivity and efficiency in the construction industry. MeltPlan addresses challenges such as fragmented multi-disciplinary teams and complex regulatory requirements by offering solutions that facilitate collaboration and reduce inefficiencies. The company also leverages on-device AI to support intelligent decision-making across different stages of construction projects. Its technology aims to reverse productivity declines in construction by enabling teams to work more effectively and coordinate across diverse tasks and trades. MeltPlan’s approach combines sophisticated computational methods with practical construction experience to deliver tools that bridge planning and execution.
